```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load data
data <- read.csv("Frequencies by lineage - All sites.csv", header = TRUE)
```


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Extract frequency columns (assuming metadata is in the first few columns)
metadata_columns <- 4 # Adjust based on your dataset structure
freq_data <- data[, (metadata_columns + 1):ncol(data)]

# Transpose frequency data for easier computation
freq_matrix <- as.matrix(freq_data)

# Compute Gene Diversity (Expected Heterozygosity) for each sample
gene_diversity <- colMeans(2 * freq_matrix * (1 - freq_matrix), na.rm = TRUE)
gene_diversity_df <- data.frame(Sample = colnames(freq_matrix), GeneDiversity = gene_diversity)

# Function to calculate Nei's Genetic Distance
nei_distance <- function(freq1, freq2) {
  1 - sum(sqrt(freq1 * freq2), na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(freq1, na.rm = TRUE) * sum(freq2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Compute Nei's Genetic Distance matrix
sample_names <- colnames(freq_matrix)
nei_dist_matrix <- matrix(0, ncol = ncol(freq_matrix), nrow = ncol(freq_matrix))
colnames(nei_dist_matrix) <- sample_names
rownames(nei_dist_matrix) <- sample_names

for (i in 1:(ncol(freq_matrix) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):ncol(freq_matrix)) {
    nei_dist_matrix[i, j] <- nei_distance(freq_matrix[, i], freq_matrix[, j])
    nei_dist_matrix[j, i] <- nei_dist_matrix[i, j]
  }
}

# Save results
write.csv(gene_diversity_df, "Gene_Diversity.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(as.data.frame(nei_dist_matrix), "Nei_Genetic_Distance.csv", row.names = TRUE)

# Print summary
print("Gene diversity and Nei's genetic distance calculated successfully.")

```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)

# Read the dataset
data <- read.csv("Frequencies by lineage - All sites.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# Identify metadata columns (adjust this if necessary)
metadata_columns <- 4 # Assuming metadata spans up to column 5
freq_data <- data[, (metadata_columns + 1):ncol(data)] # Extract frequency columns

# Extract sample names
sample_names <- colnames(freq_data)

# Define Nei's genetic distance function
nei_distance <- function(freq1, freq2) {
  # Ensure comparison only for positions with non-missing values in both samples
  valid_positions <- !is.na(freq1) & !is.na(freq2)
  freq1 <- freq1[valid_positions]
  freq2 <- freq2[valid_positions]
  
  # Calculate Nei's genetic distance
  numerator <- sum((freq1 - freq2)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  denominator <- sum(freq1 + freq2, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (denominator == 0) return(NA) # Handle cases with no valid data
  return(numerator / denominator)
}

# Initialize Nei's distance matrix
n_samples <- ncol(freq_data)
nei_dist_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_samples, ncol = n_samples,
                          dimnames = list(sample_names, sample_names))

# Calculate pairwise Nei's genetic distances
for (i in 1:(n_samples - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):n_samples) {
    nei_dist_matrix[i, j] <- nei_distance(freq_data[, i], freq_data[, j])
    nei_dist_matrix[j, i] <- nei_dist_matrix[i, j] # Symmetric matrix
  }
}

# Save the results
write.csv(as.data.frame(nei_dist_matrix), "Nei_Genetic_Distance_Adapted.csv", row.names = TRUE)

# Output success message
print("Nei's genetic distance matrix calculated and saved.")

```
